part.text: There's a variance issue with `TokenSink`. Let me fix it by using `Any` for the internal storage:

metadata.diff:
Index: /Users/wangjinhua/Library/Caches/VistaExperiments/formal-task001-local-3x3-minimaxm3-20260822-02-noskill-replicate-01/workspace/Tokenizer.scala
===================================================================
--- /Users/wangjinhua/Library/Caches/VistaExperiments/formal-task001-local-3x3-minimaxm3-20260822-02-noskill-replicate-01/workspace/Tokenizer.scala
+++ /Users/wangjinhua/Library/Caches/VistaExperiments/formal-task001-local-3x3-minimaxm3-20260822-02-noskill-replicate-01/workspace/Tokenizer.scala
@@ -81,13 +81,13 @@
   def mapTokens(func: T => String): List[String] = stored.iterator.map(func).toList
 }
 
 final class TokenSink[-T] {
-  private val received: mutable.ListBuffer[T] = mutable.ListBuffer.empty
+  private val received: mutable.ListBuffer[Any] = mutable.ListBuffer.empty
 
   def receive(item: T): Unit = received += item
 
-  def drain(): List[T] = {
+  def drain(): List[Any] = {
     val out = received.toList
     received.clear()
     out
   }
